items.escena: A clay clock face with its hands removed lying flat beside a chunky clay verb block, three identical small clay suns arranged in a repeating row behind them
A single small clay figure standing apart from a group, a thumb-sized clay tile clipped onto the end of a fat clay verb block in front of it
A fat clay verb block with a slightly wider clay tile clipped to its end, the joint between them thicker than on the block beside it
A clay letter tile being pulled off the end of a verb block by a clay hand while a wider double tile waits to take its place
A plain fat clay verb block resting alone on a base with a clean flat end and nothing clipped to it
A clay dial with five notched positions from empty to full, a small clay label tag being slid into a gap between two word blocks beside it
A chunky clay bar laid across a clay sentence rail, blocking the verb block behind it
A clay question-mark sculpture standing at the front of a clay sentence rail, the blocks behind it reordered around it
Two small clay cards standing side by side on a base, one with a raised clay check mark and the other with a raised clay cross
A clay shelf holding a small guitar, a football and a paintbrush modelled in clay, side by side
Three clay figures sitting together on a low clay park bench with nothing in their hands
A chunky clay game controller held in two clay hands in front of a small clay screen
A fat clay form board with eight empty slots, a small clay name tile pressed into the very first slot
A fat clay form board with a small clay tile pressed into the second slot while the first slot stays filled
A small clay tile stamped with a tiny clay flag, held above a form slot by a clay hand
Three small clay tiles on a counter, each carrying a modelled tool: a chalk board, a wrench and a stethoscope
A short chunky clay connector block joining a small clay figure to a clay label tile, holding them together
A clay sentence rail with a short clay wedge block inserted right after the connector, pushing the label away
A clay sentence rail whose first two blocks have been swapped, a clay question-mark sculpture standing at its end
A clay figure pointing away from itself toward a second clay figure standing on a separate small base
A clay birthday candle standing upright on a small clay cake, unlit
A small clay house with a clay mailbox on a post at its gate, an envelope resting in the box
A chunky clay envelope with a small clay at-sign shape modelled on its face
